topic: Better questions than how was school
caption:
"How was school?" "Fine." 😅 Try one of these instead and watch the stories come out.

What question gets YOUR kids talking?

#ParentingTips #ElementarySchool #TalkingWithKids #CanadianParents #FamilyTime

title: Ask this
instead
items: What was the hardest part of today?
Who did you sit with at lunch?

scenes.sub: Ask at dinner or in the car, when it feels like a chat, not a test.

scenes.source: From LearnSum: learning that feels like play
